title: Zymo Quick-DNA Fecal/Soil Microbe 96 Magbead Kit
author: Opentrons
materials: Allow user to restart protocol when ready.

steps.instruction: This protocol performs the Zymo Quick-DNA Fecal/Soil Microbe 96 Magbead Kit. Please find a description of the kit below from [Zymo's website](https://www.zymoresearch.com/collections/quick-dna-fecal-soil-microbe-kits/products/quick-dna-fecal-soil-microbe-96-magbead-kit): The Quick-DNA Fecal/Soil Microbe 96 Magbead Kits are designed for the simple and rapid isolation of inhibitor-free, PCR-quality host cell and microbial DNA from a variety of sample sources, including humans, birds, rats, mice, cattle, etc. The procedure is easy and can be completed in as little as 90 minutes: fecal samples are rapidly and efficiently lysed by bead beating with our state of the art, ultra-high density BashingBeads. Zymo MagBinding Bead technology, which features Zymo Research's Inhibitor Removal technology, is then used to isolate the DNA. Eluted DNA is ideal for downstream molecular-based applications including PCR, arrays, genotyping, methylation detection, etc. Explanation of complex parameters below: * `Number of Columns`: Specify the number of sample columns in this run (1-12). * `Pre-Wash buffer volume (ul)`: Specify wash volumes for both the pre-wash buffer, and gDNA wash buffer in microliters. Volumes can be greater than 200ul, and will be split if need be over multiple transfers. * `Magnetic Module Engage Height`: Specify the magnetic module engage height in mm. * `Elute Buffer Volume`: Specify the elute buffer volume in microliters. * `P300 Multi-Channel Pipette Mount`: Specify which mount (left or right) to host the P300 multi-channel pipette. ---

steps.title: Aspirate MagBinding Buffer
steps.instruction: Pick-up tips from slot 4 and aspirate 200ul MagBinding Buffer from troughs 1/2/3 of NEST 12 reservoir plate in slot 1 (airgap after aspiration).

steps.title: Dispense MagBinding Buffer
steps.instruction: Dispense 200 ul MagBinding Buffer into 96 well plate with pipette tip above height of wells. Do not touch plate or samples. Blowout after dispensing.

steps.title: Repeat steps 1 and 2 with MagBinding Buffer
steps.instruction: Using the same tips, repeat steps 1 and 2 twice more to add 600 ul MagBinding Buffer to each well in total. Repeat across entire plate using same tips.

steps.title: Premix MagBinding Beads
steps.instruction: Using the same tips, premix the MagBinding Beads in trough 4 of NEST 12 reservoir plate in slot 1. Mix 50 ul for 10 cycles.

steps.title: Aspirate 25 ul MagBinding Beads (airgap)
steps.instruction: Aspirate 25 ul MagBinding Beads (airgap).

steps.title: Dispense MagBinding beads
steps.instruction: Dispense 25 ul MagBinding Beads into all wells of the 96 well plate with pipette tip above height of wells. Do not touch plate or samples. Re-use tips and use blowout to avoid drips.

steps.title: Discard tips after final transfer
steps.instruction: Discard tips after final transfer.
Pause protocol.

steps.title: Seal plate and rotate
steps.instruction: Prompt user: “Seal plate and place on rotator. Rotate at low speed for 10 minutes”

steps.title: Spin-down plate
steps.instruction: Prompt user: “Now spin-down plate, unseal, and place back on mag deck.”

steps.title: Enable restart
steps.instruction: Allow user to restart protocol when ready.

steps.title: Engage magnet
steps.instruction: Engage magnet. Stand 2 minutes.

steps.title: Pick up new tips from slot 7
steps.instruction: Pick-up new tips from slot 7.

steps.title: Aspirate 166 ul supernatant into reagent trash
steps.instruction: Using slow aspiration mode (=< 50 ul/s flow rate) aspirate 166 ul supernatant and dispense into reagent trash (slot 11). Use touch tips and blowout to avoid drips.

steps.title: Remove supernatant from columns
steps.instruction: Using the same tips, repeat step 14 four more times for each column of the plate to remove 830 ul supernatant in total. Discard and change tips, taking from rack in slot 7, before moving to each new column.
Disengage magnet.

steps.title: Pick up new tips from slot 5
steps.instruction: Pick-up new tips from slot 5.

steps.title: Aspirate X µL Pre-Wash buffer
steps.instruction: Aspirate X ul Pre-Wash buffer from troughs 5-11 of NEST 12 reservoir plate in slot 1. Airgap.

steps.title: Dispense Pre-Wash buffer
steps.instruction: Dispense X ul Pre-Wash buffer into the 96 well plate with pipette tip above height of wells. Do not touch plate or samples. Blowout after dispensing.

steps.title: Add 300 ul Pre-Wash buffer to 96 well plate
steps.instruction: Using the same tips, repeat steps 17 and 18 to add a total volume of 300 ul Pre-Wash buffer to all wells of the 96 well plate. Do not change tips between columns on the plate.

steps.title: Engage magnet
steps.instruction: Engage magnet. Stand 2 minutes.

steps.title: Aspirate 150 ul supernatant using slow aspiration
steps.instruction: Using the same tips and slow aspiration mode (=< 50 ul/s flow rate) aspirate 150 ul supernatant and dispense into reagent trash (slot 11). Use touch tips and blowout to avoid drips.

steps.title: Remove 300 ul supernatant, park tips
steps.instruction: Re-using tips, repeat step 21 to remove 300 ul supernatant in total. After finishing each column, park tips in slot 8 to start a new column with a new set of tips from slot 5.
Disengage magnet.

steps.title: Pick up new tips from slot 4
steps.instruction: Pick-up new tips from slot 4.

steps.title: Aspirate X µL gDNA Wash buffer
steps.instruction: Aspirate X ul gDNA Wash buffer from NEST 1 well reservoir (troughs 7-10) in slot 1. Airgap.

steps.title: Dispense gDNA Wash buffer into 96 well plate
steps.instruction: Dispense X ul gDNA Wash buffer into the 96 well plate with pipette tip above height of wells. Do not touch plate or samples. Blowout after dispensing.

steps.title: Add 300 ul gDNA Wash buffer to wells
steps.instruction: Using the same tips, repeat steps 25 and 26 once more to add a total volume of 300 ul gDNA Wash buffer to all wells of the 96 well plate.

steps.title: Engage magnet
steps.instruction: Engage magnet. Stand 2 minutes.

steps.title: Aspirate 150 ul supernatant with slow aspiration
steps.instruction: Using parked tips from slot 8 and slow aspiration mode (=< 50 ul/s flow rate) aspirate 150 ul supernatant and dispense into reagent trash (slot 11). Use touch tips and blowout to avoid drips.

steps.title: Repeat step 29, replace tips
steps.instruction: Using the same tips, repeat step 29 once more to remove 300 ul supernatant in total. After finishing each column, change tips, using the parked tips from slot 8.

steps.title: Repeat wash with gDNA buffer
steps.instruction: Repeat steps 24 – 30 to do a second 300 ul wash with the gDNA wash buffer. Use the same parked tips for each column when removing the supernatant, but trash tips after finishing each column.

steps.title: Pause protocol, prompt user
steps.instruction: Pause protocol while keeping magnet engaged. Prompt user: “Drying for 30 minutes.”

steps.title: Allow protocol restart
steps.instruction: Allow user to restart protocol when ready.
Disengage magnet.

steps.title: Pick up new tips from slot 2
steps.instruction: Pick-up new tips from slot 2 (elution buffer tip rack).

steps.title: Aspirate DNA Elution Buffer
steps.instruction: Aspirate 50 ul DNA Elution Buffer from trough 1 of NEST 12 reservoir plate in slot 6. Airgap.

steps.title: Dispense 50 ul DNA Elution Buffer
steps.instruction: Dispense 50 ul DNA Elution Buffer into the 96 well plate with pipette tip 2mm above bottom of well.

steps.title: Mix 40ul 25 times
steps.instruction: Mix 40ul volume 25 times. Blowout and touch tips, before trashing to avoid drips.

steps.title: Engage magnet
steps.instruction: Engage magnet. Stand 2 minutes.

steps.title: Pick up tips, aspirate buffer
steps.instruction: Pick-up new tips from slot 9 (final elution tip rack). Aspirate 50ul Elution Buffer from the 96 well plate. Airgap.

steps.title: Dispense Elution Buffer
steps.instruction: Dispense 50ul Elution Buffer into the NEST 96 well 100 ul elution plate in slot 3. Trash tips.
